name: Under-eye cooling mask
lead: An under-eye cooling mask is a reusable gel or cold-pack patch worn over the lower eyelids and cheeks for a few minutes. It is used to shrink puffy eyes after sleep or a late night.
It is a quick, low-cost morning routine for a more rested look.

paras: Cooling causes vasoconstriction and reduces fluid accumulation in the loose periorbital tissue, easing swelling and redness temporarily.

Risks are very low, with rare cold urticaria or skin irritation. Evidence comes from post-surgery swelling studies, where cold gel masks outperformed ice gloves, and not from everyday puffiness, so benefits are plausible and short-lived. Persistent bags or swelling can reflect fat, allergy or medical causes cooling will not fix.
